effect_description_eng:
＜Blocker＞ (This Digimon can block in the blocker timing.)
＜Armor Purge＞ (When this Digimon would be deleted, you may trash the top card of this Digimon to prevent that deletion.)
[On Play] [When Digivolving] ＜Draw 1＞ (Draw 1 card from your deck.) Then, 1 of your Digimon with the [Royal Knight] or [CS] trait can't be returned to hands or decks by your opponent's effects until their turn ends.
